events.title: Topology seminar: Tight surgeries on torus knots
events.summary: This seminar explores the classification of tight contact structures on surgeries along torus knots, a significant advancement in understanding these complex mathematical spaces. The discussion will delve into the role of Heegaard Floer invariants and contact geometry in this classification, offering insights into advanced topological concepts.
events.experienceId: experience:["ann arbor","east hall","topology seminar tight surgeries on torus knots"]

evidence.description: Abstract: We give a complete classification of tight contact structures on every surgery along torus knots, which provides the first such classification on an infinite family of non-trivial knots and makes progress on the project of understanding tight contact structures on Seifert fibered spaces.

events.title: Neural simulation-based inference for scalable, high-fidelity spatial modeling

Discover its potential for scaling up and increasing fidelity in real-world applications.

events.title: Protostars in space and time: JWST, ALMA and time domain studies of protostellar evolution
events.summary: Explore the protostellar phase of star formation, where mass assembles, disks form, and planet formation begins. This science lecture discusses complex, time-dependent flows of mass, momentum, and energy, focusing on feedback and connections between infall and accretion, using data from JWST, ALMA, Spitzer, and WISE.
